name.description: App name, e.g. firefox, code, gnome-terminal

function.name: open_url
function.description: Open a website or URL in Firefox.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web and return result snippets.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Run a bash command and return its output.

function.name: read_screen
function.description: Read what is on the screen or in the focused window (text, errors, UI).

focus.description: Optional: what to look at, e.g. 'the error', 'terminal'

function.name: click_element
function.description: Click a button, link or item on screen, described in words.

function.name: type_text
function.description: Type text into the focused field.

function.name: press_keys
function.description: Press a keyboard shortcut, e.g. ctrl+w, alt+tab, ctrl+t.

function.name: set_volume
function.description: Set or change the system volume in percent.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file or list a folder.

function.name: get_system_info
function.description: CPU, RAM, disk, GPU, temperature, battery and top processes.

function.name: set_timer
function.description: Start a countdown timer or reminder.

function.name: delegate
function.description: Hand a multi-step task to a specialist agent: desktop (apps/files/settings), web (browse, forms, websites), research (find and compare info), comms (Outlook mail, messages), coder (debug/fix code).
